You’re too small
Mama Tau was coming home! She had been away for a long time studying, and her family missed her. Everyone was very excited. But Thapelo, the youngest of all her children, was the most excited.
Wolf’s supper
A loud howl echoed across the bushveld as Wolf woke up from a very good night’s sleep.
Why the moon gets smaller and bigger
Long ago, Mother Moon lit up the sky every night. She had a blanket woven from the most beautiful golden thread. Her blanket shone so brightly that there was enough light for all people to see their way through the darkness.
Why the bat flies at night
Once upon a time, many, many moons ago, there was a bush rat called Legotlo. Legotlo was a close friend of Mamanthwane – the bat. The two of them were always together. But Mamanthwane was jealous of Legotlo. Legotlo had many friends and …
Why monkeys live in trees
Lion was the king of the beasts. His loud roar made the leaves on the trees tremble. He spent his days hunting for food and sleeping in the sun. He was proud of his roar, and he was proud of his sharp teeth and claws, but he was most proud of his …
Why dassies have no tails
Long, long ago, animals had no tails. They were very unhappy about this, so they called a meeting at the watering hole.

Book of the Week!
Best Friends
Zindzi and Tim Tam do everything together, and Zindzi can't imagine choosing anyone else to play with. A gentle illustrated story about friendship, kindness and including others.
Latest Online Storybooks
Koschei the Deathless
A tyrant hides his soul and brings the Earth to ruin. A dark Russian folklore retelling.
Rumpelstiltskin
A dark Halloween retelling of Rumpelstiltskin, in which Rosie must outwit a nameless trickster to reclaim her own power back.
The Iron Wolf
A young man makes a deadly pact with the Iron Wolf, and must face his fears with some loyal dogs.
5 Minute Stories
5 minute stories for short and sweet snuggles before bedtime…
Jimmy the Cat and Gardening
Jimmy the Cat wants to make a garden with his friends. What should he plant?
The Elephant Who Cried Mouse!
Ronald the Elephant loves to frighten his family by calling "MOUSE!". But what happens when they stop believing him?
What’s Under That Hat?
Mr McLattice always wears a hat. What on earth could be under it?!
Zanele Sees Numbers
Zanele's family says that numbers are everywhere... but are they really?
Hubert’s Bizarre Band
Hubert the Tasmanian Devil and all his friends create a rock band!
How Jack Went To Seek His Fortune
Clever Jack has a menagerie of animals to outwit a robber gang!
Read More
Feel-Good Fairy Tales
Fairy tales that make you feel good… with all the bad bits taken out!
Princess Pink Knickers
Princess Donnabella Petronella Rosebud MUST have the most beautiful dress for her parade. But is a magic dress really a dress?
The King and the Milkmaid
A king seeks a queen... and looks for the most beautiful girl in the land.
Goldilocks and the FOUR Bears!
The REAL story of Goldilocks and the Three Bears, told by the fourth bear... Granny Growl!
Yummy, Happy, Good-Time Soup!
When Mabel meets a curious old lady in the forest, she is gifted a marvellous machine...
Cinderella (Feel Good Fairy Tales)
Ella is invited to a fancy dress ball - but she has no pretty dress! Luckily a fairy dogmother is nearby...
Little Red Riding Hood (Feel Good Fairy Tales)
Little Red Riding Hood is going to enjoy some delicious food with her Grandma... but meets big slobbery Oscar on the way!
Read More
Dark Fairy Tales
Fairy tales for older children, teens and curious readers who enjoy lyrical, authentic folk tale and mythical retellings with deeper themes.
The House on Chicken Legs
Beyond the thrice-nine kingdoms, beyond the fiery river... A dark fairy tale retelling of the fairytale Baba Yaga.
The Miraculous Secret
When Petro's parents find a bag of gold, they devise a curious prank to stop him from telling the world.
The Kingdom of the Sea Tsar
A greedy Prince dives into the Sea Tsar’s shimmering realm and demands the whole kingdom for himself. A lyrical fairy tale for older readers about misuse…
The White Cat
A magical white cat helps a Prince on his royal quest...
The Brave Life of Little Pea
The fantastic adventures of a brave boy who rescues his family from demons.
The Silver Grass Circle of Valbonne
A fairy tale about cousins Freya and Matteo, who must outwit an Elf King in an enchanted forest dance.
Read More
Age 0-3 Storybooks
Baby and toddler books designed to delight and engage the youngest readers.
Billy to the Rescue
Oh no, there's a fire! But Billy the fire-truck doesn't want to get dirty!
Amazing Daisy!
A chicken wants to learn how to fly... practice makes perfect!
Lefa’s Bath
Lefa wants a bath, but the water keeps disappearing! A no-words picture book.
Palesa Can Walk
It's Palesa's first birthday tomorrow... what gifts will she receive? The greatest one of all !
Hugs in the City
Jilly goes on a quest to hug all the cats in town!
My Little Garden
Use your imagination to tell the story in this wordless picture book about creating a garden with Dad.
Read More
Age 4-6 Storybooks
Fun stories for kinder and school aged kids
The Kingdom of the Sock Eaters
Joshua's mum tells him to tidy his socks, but when he searches behind the washing machine, he discovers a portal to a hidden world.
The Little Lie
Luca tells a little lie, that soon becomes many...
Monsieur Le Dot
The tale of a friendship between a ringmaster and an elephant at a circus everyone loves.
Izzy’s Rainbow
Izzy is so bored being inside on a rainy day! When Gran suggests she look for a rainbow, she takes matters into her own hands.
How To Tame A Monster
Lwando's little sister often turns into a monster! How can he help her?
Let’s Be Friends
Making friends is pretty hard for a friendly shark with a toothy smile. But he's going to try!
Read More
Age 7-12 Storybooks
Stories for older and more confident readers
Santa Never Forgets!
Little Bertie never remembers to do anything his mother asks him. Until one Christmas, Santa forgets!
The Weeds
The breeze helps some flowering weeds spread their seeds.
Why The Autumn Leaves Are Red
An Indian legend on why the leaves change colour in the Fall.
The Happy Prince
The status of a Prince begs a sparrow to help him bring happiness to the sad and poor of his city.
The Three Princesses in the Blue Mountain
Three Princesses must not go outside until after their fifteenth birthday...
The Friendly Frog
A friendly frog helps a queen and a princess to escape a lion witch.
Read More
Learn to Read Books
Early readers to help children read their very first books on their own
The Beginning of the Sock Eaters
The origin story of how two banana-hating friends become the first Sock Eaters!
Sam’s Treasures
Sam thinks he is collecting treasures in the garden. His sister says it is junk. Who is right?
The One in the Middle
Sometimes everyone forgets about the kid in the middle... but this kid has his ideas to keep him company!
The Special Snowman
A family has a lovely day playing in the snowy snow!
Baby’s Got The Hiccups
Baby likes to do so many things... but uh-oh! Here come the hiccups!
Unathi and the Dirty Smelly Beast
A smelly, dirty beast is following Unathi home!
Read More
Comic Books
Limited comic book series – free online!
Pepper and Carrot Comic – Episode 14
Pepper is so bored in her classes that she is willing to go the end of the earth to get some special ingredients!
Pepper and Carrot Comic – Episode 18
Carrot remembers Pepper being bullied at her last witches' school.
Pepper and Carrot Comic – Episode 15
Pepper and Carrot start playing with a crystal ball that isn't theirs... uh-oh!
Pepper and Carrot – Episode 12
The old witches of Chaosah ask Pepper to get rid of her potions - without magic. But will she listen?
Pepper and Carrot Comic – Episode 1
Episode One of the original comic book series Pepper and Carrot.
Newmon – Monster Me Comics!
Newmon keeps stealing people's pens... but then the bully is bullied. What is the best solution?
